payload.title: 12 Corfu Wedding Venues With Sea Views
payload.audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
payload.reader: An Australian couple in their 30s with a budget of AUD 150k or more, often with parents contributing, planning 40 to 150 guests who will mostly fly in from Australia via a European hub or Athens. They have settled on Corfu (or are weighing it against Crete and the Cyclades) and want a sea view to be part of the day; now they need to choose between the sheltered east coast (Kommeno, Dassia, Corfu Town, the north-east and the south-east) and the sunset-facing west, then shortlist venues compared on the same terms: ceremony options, capacity, rooms, exclusive use and how guests get there.
payload.goal: Speak with a Wedded Advisor: request a Wedded Concierge consultation so an advisor can check availability, ceremony options and house rules for the couple's shortlisted Corfu venues on their dates and guest count.
payload.angle: Every venue in this guide passes two tests on its own official site: it says it hosts weddings, and it states a sea view in its own words. On Corfu that second test matters, because the island's wedding settings split by coast: the east looks across a calm strait towards the mainland mountains, with Corfu Town and the airport close by, while the west faces open sea and the sunset with cliffs and coves. Most Corfu lists mix venue types without saying which coast they sit on or how guests reach them. This guide groups 12 venues (luxury resorts, historic estates and villas with exclusive use) by area, gives each the same fields in the same order, writes house rules a venue does not publish as 'Not published' for the Wedded Advisor to confirm in writing, and adds short sections on getting there, when to marry and the legal steps in brief.
must_include: Intro with a direct answer in the first 100 words: Corfu's wedding areas (Kommeno and Dassia, Corfu Town, the north-east, the south-east around Benitses and Moraitika, the west coast) and that the right one depends on guest count, ceremony type and the view the couple wants; link /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-venues prominently and the hub /destinations/europe/greece.

At a glance: comparison table of the final list (area, type, sea view setting, ceremony options, capacity, rooms, exclusive use) with 'Not published' where a field is not published; invitation to Wedded Concierge after the table.

How to compare like for like: resort vs historic estate vs private villa with exclusive use; ceremony type on site; seated capacity; rooms on site; transfer from Corfu airport described only from official sources.

Choosing an area: east vs west coast as practical guidance (setting, guest travel, sunset vs sheltered water) only as official tourism or venue sources state it; no unsourced distances or drive times.

12 venues grouped by area, each passing the inclusion rule on its own official site (hosts weddings AND states a sea view), same fields in the same order: location and setting; the sea view in the venue's own words; ceremony options as stated; capacity, rooms and exclusive use where published, else 'Not published'; one standout detail. Grecotel Corfu Imperial and Angsana Corfu re-checked live with fresh wording. One Advisor line per area for house rules not published, and a booking checklist. Swap failures from the reserves; do not pad (if fewer than 12 qualify, the title count changes and the person is told). No prices.
Getting there: Corfu airport from its official site; Smartraveller Greece checked live (heat and wildfire season); no transfer arrangements.
When to marry: Hellenic National Meteorological Service (hnms.gr) averages for Corfu plus venue-stated seasons (e.g. Angsana ceremony venues' stated months, re-checked).

Legal in brief: Embassy Athens and Smartraveller facts re-checked, dated as at November 2026, once; link the Greece venues guide's legal section; link /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions once. Nothing on church or religious paperwork.

FAQ (4 to 6): Which side of Corfu is best for a wedding? Can we book a venue for exclusive use? How do guests get to Corfu? When is the best time to marry in Corfu? Can Australians legally marry in Corfu?

Links: /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages, /wonderland-concierge (primary, after table and at close), /magazine as the magnet. UTMs utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=corfu-wedding-venues&utm_content=primary|secondary|magnet|closing.
avoid: Any price, fee, minimum spend or amount; any capacity, room count, distance or time not on an official source.
Sea views inferred from photos; venues without a weddings offer on their own site (Domes of Corfu unless a weddings page now exists, fact_311); Paxos or any venue off Corfu.

Research talk in copy (what we could or could not find or confirm, sources, method, 'you will often read', myths sections); per-line source credits; hedge stacking; 'often told' more than once; customs stated with meanings or origins as fact.
Ranking as 'best'; order by area with a stated logic.
Competitor wedding sites, directories, planner blogs, review sites, Facebook groups, Instagram, Pinterest or Wikipedia as sources; competitor wording or images.
Vendor names other than venues; venue contact or business details; transfer arrangements; implying partnerships or preferred rates.
Wedded Privileges; Advisor claims beyond brand-facts.md; 'from first idea to the last dance', 'last dance'; legal, church or religious paperwork detail.
Clichés (fairytale, dream day, breathtaking), exclamation marks, keywords in brackets or pasted keywords in headings, em dashes, US spelling.
AI images of any venue, destination or wedding.
